name: preview of a table named like a reserved word
join keeping every row of the starting table
sql:
SELECT o.*, c.name
FROM landing_shop.orders AS o
LEFT JOIN curated_shop.customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
LIMIT 1000

name: join keeping matching rows and chosen columns
sql:
SELECT c.name, o.order_id, o.amount
FROM curated_shop.customers AS c
INNER JOIN landing_shop.orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LIMIT 1000

name: join with a table named like a reserved word and a clashing alias
sql:
SELECT o.*, o2.order_id
FROM landing_shop."order" AS o
INNER JOIN landing_shop.orders AS o2 ON o.id = o2.customer_id
LIMIT 1000

name: join of three tables, the third suggested against the base table
sql:
SELECT o.*, c.name
FROM landing_shop.orders AS o
LEFT JOIN curated_shop.customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN landing_shop."order" AS o2 ON o.order_id = o2.id
LIMIT 1000

name: check join: matched, unmatched and row count per step
sql:
SELECT 0 AS step_order, 'c' AS step,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.customer_id AS k0 FROM landing_shop.orders AS o) AS prev INNER JOIN curated_shop.customers AS c ON prev.k0 = c.customer_id) AS matched,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.customer_id AS k0 FROM landing_shop.orders AS o) AS prev LEFT JOIN curated_shop.customers AS c ON prev.k0 = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL) AS left_without_match,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM curated_shop.customers AS c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.customer_id AS k0 FROM landing_shop.orders AS o) AS prev ON prev.k0 = c.customer_id WHERE prev.k0 IS NULL) AS right_without_match,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.customer_id AS k0 FROM landing_shop.orders AS o) AS prev LEFT JOIN curated_shop.customers AS c ON prev.k0 = c.customer_id) AS rows_after_join
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS step_order, 'o2' AS step,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.order_id AS k0 FROM landing_shop.orders AS o
LEFT JOIN curated_shop.customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id) AS prev INNER JOIN landing_shop."order" AS o2 ON prev.k0 = o2.id) AS matched,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.order_id AS k0 FROM landing_shop.orders AS o
LEFT JOIN curated_shop.customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id) AS prev LEFT JOIN landing_shop."order" AS o2 ON prev.k0 = o2.id WHERE o2.id IS NULL) AS left_without_match,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM landing_shop."order" AS o2 LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.order_id AS k0 FROM landing_shop.orders AS o
LEFT JOIN curated_shop.customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id) AS prev ON prev.k0 = o2.id WHERE prev.k0 IS NULL) AS right_without_match,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.order_id AS k0 FROM landing_shop.orders AS o
LEFT JOIN curated_shop.customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id) AS prev LEFT JOIN landing_shop."order" AS o2 ON prev.k0 = o2.id) AS rows_after_join
ORDER BY step_order

name: distribution: most frequent values, nulls included
sql:
SELECT CAST(note AS VARCHAR) AS label, count(*) AS n
FROM landing_shop.orders
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY n DESC, label
LIMIT 12

name: distribution: histogram of a decimal
sql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT min(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE)) AS lo, max(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE)) AS hi FROM landing_shop.orders)
SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN hi = lo THEN 0 ELSE LEAST(19, CAST(floor((CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) - lo) / (hi - lo) * 20) AS INT)) END AS VARCHAR) AS label,
  count(*) AS n, min(lo) AS lo, min(hi) AS hi
FROM landing_shop.orders CROSS JOIN bounds
WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1

name: distribution: histogram of a single value
sql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT min(CAST(id AS DOUBLE)) AS lo, max(CAST(id AS DOUBLE)) AS hi FROM landing_shop."order")
SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN hi = lo THEN 0 ELSE LEAST(19, CAST(floor((CAST(id AS DOUBLE) - lo) / (hi - lo) * 20) AS INT)) END AS VARCHAR) AS label,
  count(*) AS n, min(lo) AS lo, min(hi) AS hi
FROM landing_shop."order" CROSS JOIN bounds
WHERE id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1

name: distribution: size a column up before grouping by it
sql:
SELECT count(*) AS total, count(customer_id) AS filled, approx_distinct(customer_id) AS distinct_values
FROM landing_shop.orders

name: distribution: rows per day
sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('day', created_at) AS VARCHAR) AS label, count(*) AS n
FROM landing_shop.orders
WHERE created_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
